title: skills(automation references): examples-flows.md and state-machines-and-approvals.md write a CRUD filter operand as a CEL value envelope or the `{today}` placeholder
body:
Fixes #23374

Clause-②: no

Part of #22585 — the parent card, whose PR #23355 landed on `main` as `44cadd3c6d` and corrected `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md`, its eval set and `skills/objectstack-query/rules/filters.md`. Its claim surface did not cover the two reference files that ship in the same `@objectstack/skills` tarball, and both still taught the single-brace `{…}` flow token at a CRUD `filter` operand — `'{TODAY()}'`, `'{TODAY() + N}'`, `'{record.id}'` — which the platform refuses (`expression-invalid`) at `objectstack validate`, `registerFlow` and the executor. An author copying either example got a refused node. This PR makes the two reference files write what the platform accepts, and nothing it refuses. ⛔ Nothing under `packages/**`, no `SKILL.md`, no eval file changes; the platform on `main` is the ruling the text follows.

## What the text now writes, and the tree reading behind each spelling

Every spelling written into the two files has a reading on `origin/main` at `e4ec6ec1a5`:

| Written | Read from |
|:--|:--|
| `'{today}'` at a filter operand passes through to the query engine | `packages/spec/src/data/context-tokens.zod.ts:332` (`isKnownFilterToken` = `isContextToken` or `isDateMacroToken`); `data/date-macros.zod.ts:88`–`:93` (`DATE_MACRO_INSTANT_TOKENS` holds `today`); `automation/flow-value-slot-template.ts:580` (`classifyFlowFilterOperandString` answers `placeholder` for a whole-string known token) |
| `'{TODAY()}'` / `'{TODAY() + N}'` / `'{record.id}'` are refused there | `context-tokens.zod.ts:209`–`:220` (`{TODAY()}` is the documented unknown-token shape); `flow-value-slot-template.ts:228`–`:248` ("A CRUD node's filter operands": every other string carrying a `{…}` token is refused with its CEL spelling) |
| An operator's comparand (`$gte`, `$lt`) is a value slot, so an envelope sits there | `flow-value-slot-template.ts:230`–`:233` ("a field's value, an operator's comparand, each element of a list comparand") |
| `isoDate(daysFromNow(N))` is the CEL spelling of `{TODAY() + N}` | `flow-value-slot-template.ts:127`–`:132` ("The date macros"); `packages/formula/src/validate.ts:1271`–`:1272` (`daysFromNow`, `isoDate` in `CEL_STDLIB_FUNCTIONS`); `SKILL.md:233`–`:235` |
| The envelope shape `{ dialect: 'cel', source: '…' }` | `packages/spec/src/shared/expression.zod.ts:490` (the `cel` tag returns exactly that object); `SKILL.md:196`–`:198`, `:276` |
| A text slot renders `{{ }}` holes; a value slot takes a CEL envelope — the cheat sheet's new surface label | `SKILL.md:219`, `:241`–`:246` |

## Line-by-line before → after (line numbers at `e4ec6ec1a5`)

`skills/objectstack-automation/references/examples-flows.md`:

- `:41` — before: `due_date: { $lt: '{TODAY()}' },   // template token → today's date at run time` → after: `due_date: { $lt: '{today}' },   // query placeholder → today's date at run time`. This block carries the `os:check` marker, so `check:skill-examples` type-checks it.
- `:79` — before: `the start `condition` and `{record.*}` interpolation work` → after: `the start `condition` and a `record.*` CEL value envelope work`.
- `:97` — before: `// — or — withinDays: 30    // "expiring within 30 days" (negative = overdue lookback)` → after: `// — or (exactly one) — withinDays: 30   // "expiring within 30 days" (negative = overdue lookback)` (carries the one constraint of the deleted sentence below).
- `:119`–`:121` — before: three windows `{ end_date: { $gte: '{TODAY() + 7}',  $lt: '{TODAY() + 8}'  } }` … `+ 30` / `+ 31` … `+ 60` / `+ 61` → after: one window, `{ end_date: { $gte: { dialect: 'cel', source: 'isoDate(daysFromNow(7))' }, $lt: { dialect: 'cel', source: 'isoDate(daysFromNow(8))' } } }`, followed by the comment `// …and the same one-day window at 30 / 31 and at 60 / 61`. Six envelopes in place of six tokens would have cost about 66 tokens against a headroom of 10, so the code shows one tier and names the other two; the prose above it already says abutting windows tile the timeline.
- `:126`–`:129` — before: `Use `{TODAY() + N}` template tokens in CRUD-node filter values; a `cel`…`` envelope is not evaluated there and would be compared as a literal object.` → after: `Each bound is a CEL value envelope (`isoDate(daysFromNow(N))`), evaluated before the query; any `{…}` token but a query placeholder such as `{today}` is refused there (`expression-invalid`).` The old sentence's second half stated the inverse of the current contract (the envelope IS evaluated at a filter operand; the token is what is refused) — outside the card's grep, found by reading the file whole.
- `:131`–`:132` — deleted, paying the file's added tokens: `Exactly one of `offsetDays` (discrete T-minus days) or `withinDays` (a range; negative = overdue) is required.` Its home is the same file's code comments at `:96`–`:97` (`// fire exactly at T-60 / T-30 / T-7` and the `// — or (exactly one) — withinDays: 30 … (negative = overdue lookback)` line above). The paragraph now opens ``timeRelative` ships in `@objectstack/trigger-schedule``.

`skills/objectstack-automation/references/state-machines-and-approvals.md`:

- `:120` — before: `config: { objectName: 'opportunity', filter: { id: '{record.id}' }, fields: { stage: 'closed_won' } } }` → after: `config: { objectName: 'opportunity', filter: { id: { dialect: 'cel', source: 'record.id' } },` with `fields: { stage: 'closed_won' } } }` wrapped onto the next line.
- `:131` — deleted, paying the file's added tokens: `// Without them BOTH branches would execute (unguarded edges run in parallel).` Its home is the same file's comment at `:104`–`:107`: `an out-edge with NO condition ALWAYS runs (all such edges execute in PARALLEL). Guard every branch with a condition — see e4/e5 below.`
- `:334` — before: `| Flow condition / `{…}` template |` → after: `| Flow condition / CEL envelope / `{{ }}` hole |`. The time-word cheat sheet's surface label named the retired `{…}` template dialect — outside the card's enumerated lines, found by reading the file whole; same defect class, same file.

Control: `grep -nE "\{TODAY|\{NOW|'\{record\.|\{record\.\*\}|\{\$User"` plus the two prose shapes (the `cel` back-tick envelope sentence, the `{…}` template label) over the two files → 0 hits after; 6 and 2 hits on `e4ec6ec1a5`. The only brace-wrapped string literal left in either file is `'{today}'` at `examples-flows.md:41`.

## Two readings (lines and tokens; tokens are `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`'s, `ceil(utf8 bytes / 4)`)

| File | Lines before → after | Bytes before → after | Tokens before → after | Ceiling (headroom before → after) |

No ceiling moved; each file's added tokens were paid by the one deleted sentence named above, and each file ends smaller than it started.

## Gates (local, on `cee1d67425`; exit codes captured before any pipe; `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` reconciled)

- `dispatch-gates --ran`: `42 derived, 41 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`. NOT-MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` — exit 3, `PREREQUISITE NOT MET — this gate reads built output, and some package has no dist/` (only the three closures below were built; the repo-wide build is CI's). Four runs outside the derivation were recorded too (next bullets).
- `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` → exit 0: `54 authored bundle file(s) within their ceilings` (readings above).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-examples` → exit 0: `✅ 263 prose examples type-check across 3 surface(s) — every marked block parsed, so tsc ran the SEMANTIC pass on all of them`, after `packages/spec`, `client`, `client-react` and their closure were built under the verify lock (`VERDICT command-exit 0`, held 292 s, waited 0 s; 35 tasks).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-docs` → exit 0 (`✅ Skill docs in sync`); `check:skill-refs` → exit 0 (`✅ 9 generated files in sync with packages/spec`); `git status` clean after both.

Owed because `scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs:1301` (`turbo.json:767`) declares `skills/**` whole as that project's input, which covers both reference files — the dispatch assumed only `SKILL.md` was declared; the tree says otherwise.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 scripts/export-list.test.ts src/shared/retired-key-migrate-sentence.test.ts src/system/compliance-families-retirement.test.ts` → exit 0 (`Test Files 3 passed (3)`, `Tests 33 passed (33)`) — the three spec tests `cross-package-test-inputs.mjs:150`–`:175` names as readers of every `skills/**/*.md`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions` → exit 0 (`22 record-scoped formula example(s) across 474 files / 1391 TS blocks judged clean`).
- exit 0 each: `pnpm check:agent-test-spelling`, `check:changeset-gate-self-tests`, `check:corpus-claim-drift`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:driver-memory-census`, `check:dts-closure`, `check:gitlink-declared`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:objectui-changeset`, `check:pm-changeset-deadline-census`, `check:pm-governed-merges`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:published-files`, `check:refd-timer-probe`, `check:role-word`, `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`, `check:watch-hint-literal`; `node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main`, `check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base origin/main`, `check-empty-changeset.mjs --base origin/main`, `check-ci-filter-parity.mjs`, `check-closing-keyword-parity.mjs`, `check-comment-mask-corpus.mjs`, `check-doc-route-spelling.mjs --advisory`, `scripts/pm/release-rehearsal-clone.mjs --self-test`, `release-pending-publish.mjs --self-test`, and every `--self-test` the derivation lists.

Repo-wide scans (`pnpm lint`, the full `pnpm test`) are CI's.

## Changeset

`.changeset/23374-automation-references-envelopes.md` — `'@objectstack/skills': patch`. The catalog ships verbatim: `packages/skills` `build` is `scripts/sync-catalog.mjs`, which copies `skills/` into `dist/skills`, and `files[]` lists `dist`. No `skip-changeset`.

## Acceptance notes

- Observation, no card: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives neither `check:skill-docs` nor `check:skill-examples` for a `skills/**/references/*.md` diff; both run in `lint.yml`'s unfiltered lane (`:5365`, `:6488`), and the tool's own footer counts them under "the type-check lanes … outside the derived total", so CI covers them and nothing is missed — a read-only inference, noted here only.
- `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` is NOT MEASURED locally (prerequisite: every package's `dist/`); CI's repo-wide build runs it.
- Nothing of class a / b / c was found in the two files beyond the card's defect: the two extra sites it did not enumerate (`examples-flows.md:127`, `state-machines-and-approvals.md:334`) are the same defect in the same files and are corrected here.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:`objectstack-automation` 技能下两份对外发布的参考文件——`references/examples-flows.md` 与 `references/state-machines-and-approvals.md`——不再在 `update_record` 的 `filter` 操作数处教单花括号 `{…}` 旧写法(`'{TODAY()}'`、`'{TODAY() + N}'`、`'{record.id}'`)。改后示例只写平台今天接受的形状:今天的日期写查询占位符 `'{today}'`;日期偏移写 CEL 值信封 `{ dialect: 'cel', source: 'isoDate(daysFromNow(N))' }`;触发记录的 id 写 `{ dialect: 'cel', source: 'record.id' }`。顺带修正了同文件里两处同类文字:一句把「CEL 信封在 filter 里不求值」说反了的话,和时间词速查表里仍叫「`{…}` 模板」的表头。每个文件各删一句在同文件别处已有正本的重复话来支付新增字数,token 上限一个都没抬,两个文件都比改前更短。

**为什么改**:父卡 #22585 的 PR 已让 `SKILL.md` 说对了,但这两份参考文件和它装在同一个 `@objectstack/skills` 包里逐字发给每个项目,照抄示例一到 `objectstack validate` 就被拒(`expression-invalid`)。技能是 AI 作者的第一手资料,主文件和参考文件必须是同一种写法。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:纯文本改动,不碰 `packages/**`、不改运行时行为、不动 `SKILL.md` 与评测集。风险只有「新写法教错」一种,对此每一个写进文件的拼写都在正文表格里标了树上的读数来源(spec 的值槽判定模块、日期宏表、CEL 标准库)。本地门禁全绿,`check:skill-examples` 对构建后的 spec 做了类型检查,`@objectstack/rest` 以 `skills/**` 为输入的仓级测试也跑绿。回滚 = revert 本 PR(一个 commit),无迁移、无配置变化。
